title: Read several Git file contents
responsibility: Reads the requested paths at one Git revision in a single batch operation.

inputs.name: gitBlobs.root
inputs.description: The repository directory passed to Git.

inputs.name: gitBlobs.request
inputs.description: The revision and paths to read. Empty paths return an empty map without starting Git. Paths containing newline, carriage return or a null character are refused.

outputs.name: gitBlobs
outputs.description: A promise for a map from each requested path to its returned byte buffer. Duplicate paths share one map key. The Git command permits at most 64,000,000 output bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsupported paths, Git execution failures or a response with a missing header boundary or invalid size. Missing objects can produce an invalid-response error. Revision strings are passed through without separate validation.
